claim: AWS Cloud WAN lets you centralize network and security posture constructs in a single place and, by policy, segment your networks to determine who can talk to whom; network segments are routing domains that by default allow communication only within a segment.

evidence.quote: Network segments are routing domains which, by default, allow communication only within a segment.

You would have your network and security posture constructs defined in one place, and your networks in another. Cloud WAN allows you to centralize all of these constructs in a single place. By policy, you can segment your networks to determine who can talk to who, and isolate production traffic via these segments from development or test workloads, or your on premises networks.
